summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release about Bouygues Telecom deploying Perion's Outmax AI agent, achieving a 34% reduction in customer acquisition costs and 51% lower carbon intensity. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is purely operational and promotional in nature, reporting a commercial deployment. Therefore, this filing does not fall into any special-situations category.
